being the one who turned down teenage Taylor and feeling zero regrets about it is wild. richard marx heard her earliest demos, was offered the session, and walked: "i wouldn't have been any good to her." 😭

📷 minds-eye (CC BY-SA 2.0)

speak now is the only album Taylor wrote entirely alone — every song, no co-writers, at 18-20. so of course she announced the re-record the boldest way possible: onstage, mid-eras-tour, 2023. the whole re-record saga, one by one → longlivets.com/?lens=taylors-version&utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=thread

over a year of waiting to hear it off a stage — and Saturday night Taylor finally delivered "The Fate of Ophelia" live, the Showgirl lead single at last 🤍

longlivets.com/?item=vault-tloas-the-fate-of-ophelia-goes-live-for-the-first-time-closing-the&utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=news

turns out taylor's home rotation is tate mcrae, sabrina carpenter & sombr — and she went on fallon to tell everyone to go play tate's 'tit for tat.' the biggest pop star alive, hyping someone else's song like a true fan 🤍

longlivets.com/?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=heartbeat

'back to december' still wrecks me — the ONE time Taylor wrote the apology instead of getting one. fall 2009, the romance that began on a movie set 💔 every chapter, in order: https://longlivets.com/?lens=love-story&utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=thread

the thing about Lover that still gets overlooked: it was the first record Taylor ever controlled completely — her masters, her call, nobody else's name on it. 2019, and finally all the way hers 🤍

Photo: ABC News / GMA.
longlivets.com/?era=lover&utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=era-deep-cut

heartbreak in, arena tour out. the stretch right after joe jonas is where Taylor stayed single, poured it into Fearless, and by spring 2009 was headlining arenas on three continents.

the timeline, chapter by chapter → longlivets.com/?lens=love-story&utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=thread

no label fight. no asterisk. just hers. 🤍

Lover (Aug. 23, 2019) was the first album Taylor owned outright from day one — her name on the masters, start to finish. and it's no accident that the softest record she ever made is the one that was finally, fully her own.

this is the night before: Aug. 22, 2019, GMA's SummerStage in the middle of Central Park, a whole park singing it back to her before the album even existed.
